Bathroom Renovation FAQs Find answers to the most common questions about bathroom renovations in Camberwell and Melbourne. How much does a bathroom renovation cost in Camberwell? Bathroom renovation costs in Melbourne typically range from $15,000-$35,000 for standard renovations. In Camberwell's affluent market, expect: small bathroom or ensuite refresh $10,000-$20,000, mid-range full renovation $15,000-$35,000, and luxury bathroom renovations $50,000-$80,000+. Labour typically accounts for 40-60% of total costs. Heritage homes may require additional work for compliance with period-appropriate finishes. How long does a bathroom renovation take in Melbourne? Standard bathroom renovations take 2-4 weeks for the construction phase. Add 2-6 weeks for planning and permit approvals if required.
